description: A RECUSA do delete de uma STRUCTURE em uso: ProductSummary e o tipo do output Summary da server action publica Product_GetById, e as expressoes 'Summary.Name' e 'Summary.Price' escrevem-lhe os campos (base job:producer-public). O caminho limpo - reapontar com replace e so depois apagar, sem force - esta em tests/jobs/structure-refactor.json (ops 3b e 4c).

sem force: recusado com 'delete: refused, IStructure 'ProductSummary' is used by 3 consumer(s): IServerAction:Product_GetById/IAssignNode/IAssignment/IExpression; IServerAction:Product_GetById/IAssignNode/IAssignment/IExpression; IServerAction:Product_GetById/IOutputParameter:Summary (list them with usages, fix or remove those usages, or pass "force": true to break them)'.
